description:
Perform pathway (Reactome) enrichment analysis on a gene list.
Data: Open Targets Platform 25.09 · table target — one record = one Ensembl human gene.
Key: id.
Arguments: gene_list accepts ensembl gene or hgnc symbol (resolved; unknown -> error).
Results: `_vbt.total` counts all matches.
pathways: mixed direct and propagated annotations.
go: direct annotations only.
Empty vs not found: unknown identifiers are errors; an empty result is citable only as an absence. Every Ensembl human gene in Open Targets 25.09 (existence only).
BH runs over every pathway within the size bounds (zero-overlap pathways included); the background is the genes with at least one Reactome annotation; annotations are propagated to ancestor pathways.
top_level_pathways lists the exact top-level Reactome ancestors (topLevelTerm is a lossy single label).

gene_list.description: Accepts ensembl_gene, hgnc_symbol; resolved to one ensembl_gene (unknown values are errors, never empty results).
